notes: CRM notes: mid-market B2B SaaS (product docs + in-app help). Very pragmatic team — CTO (Anna Morales) cares about predictable latency and total cost. Use-case: primary search on web app (low latency ~ <120ms p95 for user-facing queries) + nightly batch embedding job (500k items) to refresh vector DB. Current stack: Postgres + Elastic for metadata, experimenting with Pinecone and Weaviate for vectors. Preference: start on Redwood Hosted API to speed launch, then move to Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput/cost when 200k MAU achieved. POC specifics: target steady 100 qps for 128-dim embeddings (inference-only qps), and 300 qps for internal analytics queries; must sustain 100 concurrent queries without >150ms tail latency for embedding inference.
poc_details: POC scope: host 10k-doc seed, integrate embeddings pipeline with Pinecone via Redwood SDK, run parallel batch ingest (500k vectors) overnight, measure steady-state token costs and per-embed latency. Success criteria: >=100 qps sustained for 30m, p95 latency <150ms for embedding endpoint, no data leakage, integration guide for Pinecone + snapshot of index sizes and cost estimates.
pricing_notes: Price sensitivity: mid-market budget but willing to commit for predictable SLA. Wants comparison: hosted per-token vs dedicated reserved GPUs cost for 3-year TCO. Ask: delta for quantized model serving (8-bit) vs FP16. Needs line-item: burst capacity pricing and overage model.
